source_scope: IEEE final paper, Fig. 2, Eqs. (1)–(20), Tables I–II, Figs. 9 and 13, balanced single-converter cases of Figs. 15–16

assumptions.power_stage: Use the author's Fig. 2 ideal current source at the PCC connected through Rline and Lline. The filter inductance Lf belongs to Fig. 1, outside the current-source equivalent. The fixed-frequency source and steps have zero phase jump.
assumptions.normalization: Vgn=1 pu. Kp and Ki are in radians per second and radians per second squared per pu detector voltage, respectively; all phase states use radians. ωgn=2π50 and Xline=ωgn Lline. Use Hz only after dividing angular frequency by 2π.
assumptions.initialization: Use the pre-fault stable root of Eq. (7) and zero frequency error, and preserve phase and unswitched integral state through the voltage/current step. In the unbounded phase portrait, the P-output can jump immediately.
assumptions.hybrid_main: Sampled implementation holds the PLL frequency on each step. Eq. (15) is evaluated with the preceding mode's raw frequency deviation as in Fig. 12, i.e. derivative of |Δf| then a signed LPF and magnitude test. Reset the integral on entering the transient proportional mode, with zero bias while in that mode. Check an alternative hold/omit policy, an absolute-derivative-first filter, and a numeric angular-ROCOF interpretation separately.
assumptions.clipping: Fig. 13 replay is unbounded as its frequency axis shows. The sampled time-domain cases use 45–55 Hz clipping, and they compare plain PI and conditional integration during clipping. Exact firmware anti-windup and sample timing remain unavailable.
assumptions.current_transition: Main cases switch the ideal current source instantaneously. The separate bounded slew sensitivities include Lline di/dt in the PCC voltage while line current changes linearly. The slew and sample periods are explicit implementation assumptions.
